localPortMustBeBetween: Local port must be between 1 and 65535
thisIsTheLocalMachine: This is the local machine. Open ports directly in the browser.
inTheBrowserBuildThe: In the browser build, the local port is opened on the machine running yi-web.
sameNumberByDefaultPicks: Same number by default; picks another if busy
hostIsOfflineConnectIt: Host is offline. Connect it before forwarding.
nothingForwardedYetEnterA: Nothing forwarded yet. Enter a port above, or click Forward in the list.
forwardAndOpenInThe: Forward and open in the browser
remoteIntro: Connect a port on {{name}} to localhost so you can open remote pages and APIs in this browser. Traffic only reaches 127.0.0.1 on the host, and this side only listens on 127.0.0.1. Forwards end when the app closes.
